text.text: Lynn’s massage was nothing short of blissful relaxation. She gladly created a bespoke session to provide the right kind of treatment I needed after a short consultation before beginning. The environment has a great selection of music and smells which allow you to feel safe and relaxed from the get go. I’m already looking forward to the next time I can treat myself by coming here.
